messages.author: Ingrid Voss
messages.text: Cutover was the 03-02 file. February partitions ran on v2.3 and stand. Thursday night's run crashed outright, so 03-05 never loaded at all.

messages.author: Rei Tanaka
messages.text: STD's day window Wednesday is free; five attribution partitions at 45 minutes each fit one window. Thursday night is the replication window — protected.

messages.author: Ingrid Voss
messages.text: Nobody imputes consent fields in SQL, and a full raw-archive rebuild is a separate request to me — the approval covers the five re-exported days only.
